bottom_line.core_idea: An empanelled BFSI system integrator, not a hardware trader.
bottom_line.hidden_insight: Cash conversion, not the book, decides what holders keep — debtors at 154 days.
bottom_line.open_question: Can a 6%-margin SI collect receivables fast enough to fund growth?
bottom_line.takeaway: Own execution, watch receivables. Cheap at 15x if the book converts.
bottom_line.what_breaks: Concentration + BFSI capex pause stalls the Rs 2,964 Cr book fast.
bottom_line.what_changed: Lumpy SI billing → 5–7 yr annuity contracts (DaaS, SD-WAN, SOC).

financial_snapshot.note: TTM to 25 Sep 2026 — SI growth at a discount: Revenue +11% TTM on 11% OPM. ROE 31.1% at 15.3x P/E.

forecast.note: Shares flat at ~1.27 Cr (FV Rs 10) — borrowings fund working capital, no dilution assumed. Bear = BFSI capex pause + hardware-mix margin slip + derate to 12x. Base = book converts + pipeline drips at 30% win, mild re-rating 15.3x → 18x. Bull = AI-ready DC + SOC-led annuity surge, P/E held at 22x.

local_crosscheck.note: Local screener cross-check: trailing 15.3x, P/B 4.1x, OPM 11% TTM — AlphaSpread DCF/Multiples both imply 30-56% upside; EY lens implies Rs 1,805 at 3.7%.

valuation.methodology: AlphaSpread live Sep 27, 2026 — 7-year Net Income template, Revenue Growth 15.5% (vs 5Y hist 26.7%), Net Margin 5.9%→4.8% (vs 5Y hist 4.7%), Discount Rate 11.0%, Terminal Growth 0%. Multiples-Based from P/E, P/S, P/OCF, P/B, EV/Sales/EBITDA/EBIT vs peers/history. Intrinsic = equal blend (DCF Rs 1,324.18 + Multiples Rs 1,595.90).

vision.oneline: Dynacons makes bank infrastructure boringly reliable — “strong execution” is the engineering promise; “robust order book” is the visibility promise.
